name: workshop
description: Default profile: an assessor in a populated installation; every lens has data.

ready.description: Everything is fetched; the Due list is populated.

saved-by-other.description: Another assessor saved two answers of Strategy and Metrics in the open assessment; a document-saved event follows, and the assessment reads with them.

conflict.description: Another assessor saved the same answers of Strategy and Metrics first: a save for everyone answers CONFLICT with both values.

forbidden.description: The rights were withdrawn meanwhile: the Due list is refused.

session-replaced.description: Another login in the same browser replaced the session: the open event streams close and the session gets a new anti-CSRF token; the tab reads the session again and reloads.

session-ended.description: The provider ended the session (back-channel logout): the event streams close and the next request answers UNAUTHENTICATED.

preview-hostile.description: The renderer answers HTML that the allow-list must cut down: the web app shows no script, no handler, no unsafe link.

preview-unavailable.description: The renderer cannot run: no preview, the editing goes on.

note-created.description: The first save of a new note answered CREATED: the list holds the new note (Phishing drill notes) and the lists refresh.

note-submitted.description: The Incident communication checklist was submitted for review: it reads in review, and the release of it is possible.

note-released.description: The Incident communication checklist was released as v1: it reads released, and a save reopens it as version 2.

note-reopened.description: The Incident communication checklist was saved after its release: it is a draft again, version 2, and the release v1 is the last one.

note-saved-by-other.description: Jordan Weber saved the status and the details of the Retention schedule, fields the user's own draft does not touch: a document-saved event follows, and the note reads with them; the draft stays.

note-conflict.description: Jordan Weber saved the same two fields of the Retention schedule first: the next save answers CONFLICT with both values; the decided values then go through.

note-conflict-resolved.description: The conflict was decided: the next save of the Retention schedule is accepted with the following blob.

note-invalid.description: The server refuses a save, a draft and a create with three per-field errors (reference, person, length).

note-released-meanwhile.description: Somebody released the Retention schedule while it was open: a save answers DOCUMENT_RELEASED and the draft stays.

note-rejected.description: The Git server refuses the push: a save, a submit, a create and a release answer REJECTED and write nothing.

note-git-unavailable.description: The Git server of the test notes cannot be reached: reads, lists, revisions, the search and the draft still work; a save, a submit, a create and a release answer GIT_UNAVAILABLE.

note-submit-step-up.description: The submit of the Retention schedule asks for a fresh login first; after it the same request passes.

note-submit-stepped-up.description: The fresh login of the submit is done: the Retention schedule is submitted for review.

note-release-step-up.description: The release of the Supplier security questionnaire asks for a fresh login first; after it the same request passes.

note-release-stepped-up.description: The fresh login of the release is done: the release of the Supplier security questionnaire is accepted.

note-release-done.description: The Supplier security questionnaire is released as v1.

note-release-password.description: Local users: the release asks for the password and sends it with the request.

note-release-wrong-password.description: Local users: a wrong password; nothing is released.

note-release-changed.description: Somebody saved the Supplier security questionnaire after the review was opened: the release answers CHANGED_SINCE_REVIEW, the review reads the new text and diff.

note-release-changed-refused.description: The release was refused as changed since the review: it stays refused until the new text and diff are read again; the next read of the diff is that review.

note-release-changed-reviewed.description: The new text and diff were read after the refusal: the release of the Supplier security questionnaire is accepted.

note-release-changed-done.description: The Supplier security questionnaire is released as v1, with the text Jordan Weber saved after the review was opened.

note-release-too-many-logins.description: Every place of pending logins is taken: the release cannot start its step-up; nothing is written.

note-release-incomplete.description: The server's own check finds a mandatory field of the Supplier security questionnaire empty that the review did not show: the release answers MANDATORY_FIELDS_MISSING and writes nothing.

note-release-released-meanwhile.description: Somebody released the Supplier security questionnaire while the review was open: the release answers DOCUMENT_RELEASED, and the document reads released now.

note-release-request.description: The release request of the Access review cadence (Jordan Weber) is open: the release is accepted, the note then reads released as v2 and the request leaves the Due list.

note-release-request-done.description: The Access review cadence is released as v2: it reads released, and its request has left the Due list.

note-save-password.description: Local users: the first save of the Retention schedule asks for the password (STEP_UP_REQUIRED without an address); the same save with the password passes.

note-save-password-done.description: Local users: the password of the save was given; the Retention schedule saves.

note-submit-password.description: Local users: the submit of the Retention schedule asks for the password (STEP_UP_REQUIRED without an address); the same submit with the password passes.

note-submit-password-done.description: Local users: the password of the submit was given; the Retention schedule is submitted.

note-submit-password-declared.description: Local users: the read of the Retention schedule declares that the submit needs the confirmation, so the dialog opens before the request; the submit passes.

note-submit-wrong-password.description: Local users: the submit of the Retention schedule, which declares the confirmation, gets a wrong password; nothing is submitted.

note-save-wrong-password.description: Local users: the first save of the Retention schedule asks for the password (STEP_UP_REQUIRED without an address), the repeated one gets a wrong password; nothing is saved.

note-save-wrong-password-retry.description: Local users: the password of the save was wrong; the Retention schedule is not saved and every further save with a password answers INVALID_CREDENTIALS.

note-save-too-many-logins.description: Every place of pending logins is taken: the save of the Retention schedule cannot start its step-up; nothing is written.

note-submit-too-many-logins.description: Every place of pending logins is taken: the submit of the Retention schedule cannot start its step-up; nothing is submitted.

note-search-refused.description: The search is refused (the right to read was withdrawn meanwhile): GET /api/v1/search answers FORBIDDEN.

category-two.description: Two generic categories: Test notes and Meeting minutes (Meeting minutes has two documents, one a draft, one released once and frozen); the search finds the minutes too.

category-switched-off.description: Meeting minutes is switched off but still holds documents: the categories list it with enabled false; its documents, revisions, schema and the search stay readable, every write answers FORBIDDEN. Test notes stays on.

category-only-switched-off.description: Meeting minutes is the only generic category and it is switched off: no entry of the rail, the documents stay readable at their addresses and in the search, every write answers FORBIDDEN.

confirmation-due.description: The own directory entry is older than the interval: the session says directoryConfirmationDue; confirming or saving the entry ends the notice.

confirmation-done.description: The own entry is confirmed today: the session says false, the entry shows today's date.

entry-invalid.description: Saving the own entry is refused: the team is not in the catalog.

entry-git-unavailable.description: The Git server of the directory cannot be reached: saving the own entry and confirming it answer GIT_UNAVAILABLE.

scope-created.description: The scope Mobile Apps was created: the list and the scope read show it without an assessment, its trend is empty, a save of its targets answers SAVED, and the event document-created tells an open list.

scope-invalid.description: Creating a scope is refused: the title is missing, the subject is in no catalog, a target is not a step of the model and a due date is no date.

targets-saved.description: The targets of Payments were saved (ta 3, rt 2, om removed): the scope read shows them with the new blob, and the event document-saved tells an open scope sheet.

targets-invalid.description: Saving the targets of Payments is refused: a target is not a step of the model and a due date is no date.

targets-conflict.description: Jordan Weber saved the target of the practice ta first: the next save of the targets answers CONFLICT with both entries; the decided value then goes through.

targets-conflict-resolved.description: The conflict of the targets was decided: the next save is accepted and the scope shows the targets.

shop-assessment-created.description: The assessment Web shop 2026 Q4 was created (draft, empty): the list and the scope read show it as the open one, the read of it is empty, a second create is refused with ASSESSMENT_OPEN, and the event document-created tells an open list.

organisation-assessment-created.description: The assessment Organisation 2026 H2 was created (draft, empty): the list and the scope read show it as the open one, the read of it is empty, a second create is refused with ASSESSMENT_OPEN, and the event document-created tells an open list.

assessment-invalid.description: Creating an assessment of Web shop or Organisation is refused: the date is no date, the model version is not pinned and the second assessor is unknown.

assessment-released-meanwhile.description: Noor Haddad released Payments 2026 Q4 while it was open: a save, a draft, a submit and a release answer DOCUMENT_RELEASED, the assessment, the scope, the list and the trend read as released, and the event document-transitioned tells an open sheet.

evidence-invalid.description: Saving a practice of Payments 2026 Q4 is refused, as is its draft: a link is no https address, another has no title, and a comment is too long.

model-versions-differ.description: The comparison of Payments answers MODEL_VERSIONS_DIFFER for 2026-q2 (v2.1.0) and 2026-q4 (v2.2.0); the data of the two assessments still say v2.2.0.

models-none.description: The installation pins no model version: the list of the models is empty, so the web app offers no new scope and no new assessment.

samm-git-unavailable.description: The Git server of the SAMM assessments cannot be reached: the status is degraded and the creates and the save of the targets answer GIT_UNAVAILABLE; the draft and every read still work.
